description: Leaking toilet outlet pipe with a bucket catching drips
caption:
If there's a bucket doing a pipe's job in your bathroom, you already know something needs sorting. This kind of leak at the toilet outlet doesn't fix itself, and it usually gets worse (and messier) the longer it's ignored.

This is what a mixer tap looks like after years of hard water buildup - corroded, stiff to turn, and usually leaking somewhere you can't see yet.

If yours looks anything like this, it's not just cosmetic. Worn seals inside eventually mean a proper leak, not just an ugly tap.
